CheckTitle: DynamoDB DAX Clusters without encryption at rest
Description: DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) Clusters appear to not have SSE (Server-Side Encryption) at rest enabled.
Risk: Without encryption at rest, cached data blocks containing sensitive information are vulnerable to data exfiltration and unauthorized access, impacting confidentiality and integrity of session states, API responses etc..

Recommendation.Text: Ensure SSE-KMS (Server-Side Encryption, Key Management System) preferably using CMK (Customer-managed keys) is enabled for all clusters.
